outputs.preconditions:
- The applicant must be a working parent or a person exercising parental responsibility, including a biological, adoptive or foster parent, or a presumed mother under Article 1464 of the Civil Code who has a child through surrogacy.

- The child must be under eight (8) years of age.

- The applicant must be employed either under a dependent-employment relationship or under a paid mandate, in the private or public sector. In the public sector, the subsidy is available only to employees covered by labour legislation.

- The applicant must have completed one (1) year of employment with the same employer, whether continuously or through successive fixed-term employment contracts, unless more favourable terms are provided by specific legislation, decrees, regulations, collective labour agreements, arbitration awards, or oral or written employer–employee agreements.

- The employer must upload the parental-leave grant form (Form E.14) to the ERGANI Information System.

- For online submission, the applicant must hold TAXISnet credentials to access DYPA electronic services through certification by the Independent Authority for Public Revenue (AADE).

- The applicant must be registered in DYPA’s Register of Natural Persons and hold a DYPA Registration Number; where not already registered, registration is completed electronically using TAXISnet credentials, following verification by AADE.

- The applicant must be a working parent or a person exercising parental responsibility, including a biological, adoptive or foster parent, or a presumed mother under Article 1464 of the Civil Code who has a child through surrogacy.

- The child must be under eight (8) years of age.

- The applicant must be employed either under a dependent-employment relationship or under a paid mandate, in the private or public sector. In the public sector, the subsidy is available only to employees covered by labour legislation.

- The applicant must have completed one (1) year of employment with the same employer, whether continuously or through successive fixed-term employment contracts, unless more favourable terms are provided by specific legislation, decrees, regulations, collective labour agreements, arbitration awards, or oral or written employer–employee agreements.

- The employer must upload the parental-leave grant form (Form E.14) to the ERGANI Information System.

- For online submission, the applicant must hold TAXISnet credentials to access DYPA electronic services through certification by the Independent Authority for Public Revenue (AADE).

- The applicant must be registered in DYPA’s Register of Natural Persons and hold a DYPA Registration Number; where not already registered, registration is completed electronically using TAXISnet credentials, following verification by AADE.

- The applicant must be a working parent or a person exercising parental responsibility, including a biological, adoptive or foster parent, or a presumed mother under Article 1464 of the Civil Code who has a child through surrogacy.

- The child must be under eight (8) years of age.

- The applicant must be employed either under a dependent-employment relationship or under a paid mandate, in the private or public sector. In the public sector, the subsidy is available only to employees covered by labour legislation.

- The applicant must have completed one (1) year of employment with the same employer, whether continuously or through successive fixed-term employment contracts, unless more favourable terms are provided by specific legislation, decrees, regulations, collective labour agreements, arbitration awards, or oral or written employer–employee agreements.

- The employer must upload the parental-leave grant form (Form E.14) to the ERGANI Information System.

- For online submission, the applicant must hold TAXISnet credentials to access DYPA electronic services through certification by the Independent Authority for Public Revenue (AADE).

- The applicant must be registered in DYPA’s Register of Natural Persons and hold a DYPA Registration Number; where not already registered, registration is completed electronically using TAXISnet credentials, following verification by AADE.

Επίσης, κατά τη διάρκεια της επιδότησηςοι δικαιούχοι ασφαλίζονται στον κλάδο κύριας σύνταξης και ασθένειας του e-ΕΦΚΑ και στον κλάδο επικουρικής ασφάλισης.Τελευταία ενημέρωση09/04/2025ΑίτησηΤύπος αίτησηςΑίτησηΚατάθεσηΚατάθεση από τον αιτούντα (ψηφιακή)Κατατίθεται απόΦυσικά πρόσωπαΤίτλοςΑίτηση χορήγησης του επιδόματος γονικής αδείας.Σχετικός σύνδεσμοςΣύνδεσμος (https://eservices.oaed.gr/pls/apex/f?p=1001:1:0:::::)Τι θα χρειαστείτεΜέσα εξακρίβωσης της ταυτότητας, ταυτοποίησης και υπογραφήςΤαυτοποίηση με κωδικούς TAXISnet

Η εγγραφή συντελείται ηλεκτρονικά μεκωδικούς TAXISNET μέσω επαλήθευσης των στοιχείων τηςενδιαφερόμενης από την Ανεξάρτητη Αρχή Δημοσίων Εσόδων (ΑΑΔΕ).ΣύνδεσμοςΣύνδεσμος (https://eservices.oaed.gr/pls/apex/f?p=1001:1:)ΕργασιακέςΑπασχόληση, είτε με σχέση εξαρτημένης εργασίας, είτε με έμμισθη εντολήστον ιδιωτικό τομέα ή στον δημόσιο τομέα (Αναφορικά με τον δημόσιοτομέα, δικαιούχοι επιδότησης από τη Δ.ΥΠ.Α. είναι οι εργαζόμενοι πουυπάγονται στην εργατική νομοθεσία).ΣύνδεσμοςΣύνδεσμος (https://www.dypa.gov.gr/epidoma-gonikis-adeias)ΠιστοποίησηςΑνάρτηση Εντύπου Χορήγησης της γονικής αδείας από τον εργοδότη(Έντυπο Ε.14) στο ΠΣ ΕΡΓΑΝΗ.ΣύνδεσμοςΣύνδεσμος (https://www.dypa.gov.gr/epidoma-gonikis-adeias)ΕργασιακέςΣυμπλήρωση ενός (1) έτους συνεχόμενης ή με διαδοχικές συμβάσειςεργασίας ορισμένου χρόνου στον ίδιον εργοδότη, εκτός αν ορίζεταιευνοϊκότερα από ειδική διάταξη νόμου, διαταγμάτων, κανονισμών,συλλογικών συμβάσεων εργασίας, διαιτητικών αποφάσεων ή συμφωνιώνεργοδοτών και εργαζομένων (προφορικών ή γραπτών).ΣύνδεσμοςΣύνδεσμος (https://www.dypa.gov.gr/epidoma-gonikis-adeias)ΗλικιακέςΤο παιδί να μην έχει συμπληρώσει την ηλικία των οκτώ (8) ετών.ΣύνδεσμοςΣύνδεσμος (https://www.dypa.gov.gr/epidoma-gonikis-adeias)ΣχετικάΈννομα μέσα προστασίας ή έφεσης:Οι ενδιαφερόμενοι/-ες έχουν το δικαίωμα άσκησης Αίτησης Θεραπείας ή Ιεραρχικής Προσφυγής κατά το άρθρο 24 του ν. 2690/1999,ως ισχύει, είτε από τη διοικητική αρχή η οποία εξέδωσε την πράξη (ΚΠΑ2) την ανάκληση ή την τροποποίησή της (αίτηση θεραπείας),είτε, από την αρχή η οποία προΐσταται εκείνης που εξέδωσε την πράξη (Περ/κή Δ/νση) την ακύρωσή της (ιεραρχική προσφυγή).Επίσης, οι ενδιαφερόμενοι/-ες δύνανται να υποβάλουν οποιαδήποτε καταγγελία προς τη Δ.ΥΠ.Α. μέσω του Οδηγού του πολίτη στηνηλεκτρον. δ/νση: (Σύνδεσμος ) ή να συμπληρώσουν την αντίστοιχη φόρμα στον ιστότοπο της ΔΥΠΑ (Σύνδεσμος) ή να καλέσουν στις

ΠεριγραφήΟι πληρωμές γίνονται αφού συμπληρωθεί έκαστος ημερολογιακός μήνας της άδειας, εντός της 1ηςεβδομάδος του επόμενου μήνα. Έως την ολοκλήρωση της αυτοματοποιημένης διαδικασίας τωνπληρωμών μέσω του ΟΠΣ της Δ.ΥΠ.Α., οι μηνιαίες αποφάσεις καταβολής αποστέλλονται από ταΚΠΑ2 προς τις αντίστοιχες Περ/κές Δ/νσεις, οι οποίες εκδίδουν τα εντάλματα πληρωμής και τααποστέλλουν προς την τράπεζα για να πιστωθεί το ποσό στο λογαριασμό των δικαιούχων. Τοποσό πιστώνεται αμέσως, εκτός εάν πρόκειται για διατραπεζική συναλλαγή, οπότε απαιτούνταιαπό δύο (2) έως τρεις (3) ημέρες επιπλέον.5Έκδοση Απορριπτικής ΑπόφασηςΑρμόδιοςδιεκπεραίωσηςΑρμόδιος ΤμηματάρχηςΤρόπος ΥλοποίησηςΥπογραφήΠεριγραφήΣτην περίπτωση που δεν πληρούνται οι νόμιμες προϋποθέσεις της επιδότησης, αφού ελεγχθεί τοαποτέλεσμα της εξέτασης της αίτησης από τον/την αρμόδιο/-α ελεγκτή/-έγκτρια, εκδίδεται απότον/την Προϊστάμενο/-μένη του αρμόδιου ΚΠΑ2 απορριπτική απόφαση.

inputs.preconditions:
- The applicant must be a working parent or a person exercising parental responsibility, including a biological, adoptive or foster parent, or a presumed mother under Article 1464 of the Civil Code who has a child through surrogacy.

- The child must be under eight (8) years of age.

- The applicant must be employed either under a dependent-employment relationship or under a paid mandate, in the private or public sector. In the public sector, the subsidy is available only to employees covered by labour legislation.

- The applicant must have completed one (1) year of employment with the same employer, whether continuously or through successive fixed-term employment contracts, unless more favourable terms are provided by specific legislation, decrees, regulations, collective labour agreements, arbitration awards, or oral or written employer–employee agreements.

- The employer must upload the parental-leave grant form (Form E.14) to the ERGANI Information System.

- For online submission, the applicant must hold TAXISnet credentials to access DYPA electronic services through certification by the Independent Authority for Public Revenue (AADE).

- The applicant must be registered in DYPA’s Register of Natural Persons and hold a DYPA Registration Number; where not already registered, registration is completed electronically using TAXISnet credentials, following verification by AADE.

inputs.preconditions:
- The applicant must be a working parent or a person exercising parental responsibility, including a biological, adoptive or foster parent, or a presumed mother under Article 1464 of the Civil Code who has a child through surrogacy.

- The child must be under eight (8) years of age.

- The applicant must be employed either under a dependent-employment relationship or under a paid mandate, in the private or public sector. In the public sector, the subsidy is available only to employees covered by labour legislation.

- The applicant must have completed one (1) year of employment with the same employer, whether continuously or through successive fixed-term employment contracts, unless more favourable terms are provided by specific legislation, decrees, regulations, collective labour agreements, arbitration awards, or oral or written employer–employee agreements.

- The employer must upload the parental-leave grant form (Form E.14) to the ERGANI Information System.

- For online submission, the applicant must hold TAXISnet credentials to access DYPA electronic services through certification by the Independent Authority for Public Revenue (AADE).

- The applicant must be registered in DYPA’s Register of Natural Persons and hold a DYPA Registration Number; where not already registered, registration is completed electronically using TAXISnet credentials, following verification by AADE.

### SYSTEM INSTRUCTIONS
You are a SHACL Expert. Your task is to generate a strictly valid SHACL file (Turtle format) to validate a Knowledge Graph against a set of constraints.

### INPUTS
1.  **Information Model (JSON):** An array of constraint objects. Each constraint identifies the required data variables (constrains) and how to find them in the graph (related_paths).
2.  **Domain Ontology (TTL):** The definitions of the classes and properties used in the paths. 

### OUTPUT
A single `.ttl` file containing `sh:NodeShape` definitions. DO NOT wrap the output in markdown code blocks; return ONLY the raw Turtle string. 

### GENERATION RULES

1.  **Targeting:**
    * Every Shape MUST target the class `:Applicant`.
    * Use: `sh:targetClass :Applicant ;`.

2.  **Namespace & Prefixes:**
    * Use the namespace defined in the Domain Ontology for all properties (`@prefix : <http://example.org/schema#> .`).
    * Use the example namespace for the shapes (`@prefix ex: <http://example.org/> .`).
    * Include standard prefixes: `sh:`, `xsd:`, `rdf:`, `rdfs:`.

3.  **Path Resolution:**
    * The `path` arrays in the JSON are lists of predicate names (strings).
    * You must prepend the default namespace (e.g., `:`) to these strings to create valid URIs (e.g., "hasParent" -> `:hasParent`).
    * All paths originate from the **Focus Node** (the `:Applicant`).
    * Use the related_paths in the JSON strictly as a dictionary to know which Ontology properties exist. DO NOT blindly chain them together. You must read the natural language desc to understand the true relational graph topology (e.g., realizing that multiple properties belong to the same Blank Node) and construct your SPARQL WHERE clauses based on the English logic, not the flat JSON arrays.

3.5. **Empty Constraints:**
    * If a Constraint object in the JSON Information Model has an empty `constrains` array (no InformationConcepts), this means the precondition could not be mapped to any property in the Domain Ontology.
    * Do NOT generate a `sh:NodeShape` for this Constraint. Skip it entirely.
    * Do NOT generate a stub shape with only `sh:targetClass` and an explanatory `sh:message` — such a shape has no constraint component and will cause the validation engine to fail.

4.  **Logic Strategy (Property vs. SPARQL):**
    * **Strategy A: Simple Property Shapes**
        * Use ONLY if there is exactly **one** concept with **one** path, and the logic is a simple check (e.g., `minCount`, `minInclusive`, `hasValue`).
        * *Example:* "Income > 1000" on a direct path.
    * **Strategy B: SPARQL Constraints (Default for Complexity)**
        * Use for **ANY** of the following:
            * **Multiple Paths:** (e.g., Applicant's income + Parent's income).
            * **Identity/URI Checks:** (e.g., "City A must be different from City B").
            * **Aggregations:** (Sum, Count).
            * **Complex Math:** (Income > 3000 + (300 * children)).

5.  **SPARQL Syntax Rules:**
    * Use `?this` to refer to the focus node (:Applicant).
    * **Do NOT use Property Paths** (e.g., `ex:p1/ex:p2`) in the WHERE clause. Break them down into explicit triple patterns for robustness.
        * *Bad:* `?this :hasParent/:hasIncome ?val .`
        * *Good:* `?this :hasParent ?p . ?p :hasIncome ?val .`
    * **Datatype Handling:**
        * If JSON datatype is `"URI"`, compare variables directly (e.g., `FILTER (?city1 != ?city2)`).
        * If JSON datatype is numeric (`xsd:decimal`), perform arithmetic comparisons.

6.  **Message:**
    * Generate a clear `sh:message` explaining the violation (usually the inverse of the `desc`).

7.  **Date & Duration Logic:**
    * Use `now()` to represent the current date/time. For example:
    * To calculate **Age** (Years): Use `(YEAR(now()) - YEAR(?birthDate))`.
    * To calculate **Elapsed Months** (Duration): Use `((YEAR(now()) * 12 + MONTH(now())) - (YEAR(?startDate) * 12 + MONTH(?startDate)))`.
    * Always use these mathematical breakdowns rather than subtracting dates directly, as `xsd:duration` support varies by validator.

### EXAMPLES

**Example 1: Identity Check (URI Comparison)**
*JSON Input:*
[
    {
    "name": "different_city_condition",
    "desc": "Student residence must be in a different city than family.",
    "constrains": [
        { "name": "stud_city", "related_paths": [{ "path": ["hasCurrentResidence", "locatedIn"], "datatype": "URI" }] },
        { "name": "fam_city", "related_paths": [{ "path": ["hasFamilyResidence", "locatedIn"], "datatype": "URI" }] }
        ]
    }
]
*SHACL Output:*
:different_city_shape
    a sh:NodeShape ;
    sh:targetClass :Applicant ;
    sh:sparql [
        a sh:SPARQLConstraint ;
        sh:message "Student residence is in the same city as the family residence." ;
        sh:select """
            SELECT ?this
            WHERE {
                # Path 1: Student City
                ?this :hasCurrentResidence ?res .
                ?res :locatedIn ?stud_city .
                
                # Path 2: Family City
                ?this :hasFamilyResidence ?fres .
                ?fres :locatedIn ?fam_city .
                
                # Constraint: Must be different
                FILTER (?stud_city = ?fam_city)
            }
        """ ;
    ] .

**Example 2: Aggregation (Summing across paths)**
*JSON Input:*
[
    {
    "name": "income_limit_condition",
    "desc": "Total family income must be less than 30000.",
    "constrains": [
            { "name": "family_income", "related_paths": [
                { "path": ["hasIncome", "amount"], "datatype": "xsd:decimal" },
                { "path": ["hasParent", "hasIncome", "amount"], "datatype": "xsd:decimal" }
                ]
            }
        ]
    }
]
*SHACL Output:*
:income_limit_shape
    a sh:NodeShape ;
    sh:targetClass :Applicant ;
    sh:sparql [
        a sh:SPARQLConstraint ;
        sh:message "Total family income exceeds 30000." ;
        sh:select """
            SELECT ?this
            WHERE {
                {
                    # Step 2: Sum the values of those distinct nodes
                    SELECT ?this (SUM(?val) as ?total)
                    WHERE {
                        # Step 1: Isolate DISTINCT property nodes to prevent double-counting shared graphs
                        SELECT DISTINCT ?this ?node ?val
                        WHERE {
                            {
                                # Path A: Applicant
                                ?this :hasIncome ?node .
                                ?node :amount ?val .
                            }
                            UNION
                            {
                                # Path B: Parent
                                ?this :hasParent ?par .
                                ?par :hasIncome ?node .
                                ?node :amount ?val .
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    GROUP BY ?this
                }
                FILTER (?total > 30000)
            }
        """ ;
    ] .

inputs.preconditions:
- The applicant must be a working parent or a person exercising parental responsibility, including a biological, adoptive or foster parent, or a presumed mother under Article 1464 of the Civil Code who has a child through surrogacy.

- The child must be under eight (8) years of age.

- The applicant must be employed either under a dependent-employment relationship or under a paid mandate, in the private or public sector. In the public sector, the subsidy is available only to employees covered by labour legislation.

- The applicant must have completed one (1) year of employment with the same employer, whether continuously or through successive fixed-term employment contracts, unless more favourable terms are provided by specific legislation, decrees, regulations, collective labour agreements, arbitration awards, or oral or written employer–employee agreements.

- The employer must upload the parental-leave grant form (Form E.14) to the ERGANI Information System.

- For online submission, the applicant must hold TAXISnet credentials to access DYPA electronic services through certification by the Independent Authority for Public Revenue (AADE).

- The applicant must be registered in DYPA’s Register of Natural Persons and hold a DYPA Registration Number; where not already registered, registration is completed electronically using TAXISnet credentials, following verification by AADE.

Εθνικό Μητρώο ΔιοικητικώνΔιαδικασιών505464Επίδομα Γονικής ΆδειαςΜε μια ματιάΣημεία εξυπηρέτησηςΔιεύθυνση ασφάλισης και κοινωνικών πολιτικών, ΔΗΜΟΣΙΑ ΥΠΗΡΕΣΙΑ ΑΠΑΣΧΟΛΗΣΗΣ (Δ.ΥΠ.Α.)Ψηφιακά σημεία παροχήςΕνιαία Ψηφιακή Πύλη δημόσιας διοίκησης (ΕΨΠ - gov.gr) (https://www.gov.gr/ipiresies/ergasia-kai-asphalise/apozemioseis-kai-parokhes/epidoma-gonikes-adeias)Αριθμός δικαιολογητικών1ΚόστοςΠαρέχεται χωρίς κόστοςΕκτιμώμενος χρόνος3 μήνεςΠεριγραφήΗ διαδικασία αφορά στη χορήγηση επιδόματος γονικής άδειας. Η εν θέματι παροχή χορηγείται από τη Δημόσια ΥπηρεσίαΑπασχόλησης (Δ.ΥΠ.Α.) για τους πρώτους δύο (2) μήνες γονικής αδείας διάρκειας έως τέσσερις (4) μήνες.Βασικές πληροφορίεςΘεσμικός φορέαςΥΠΟΥΡΓΕΙΟ ΕΡΓΑΣΙΑΣ ΚΑΙ ΚΟΙΝΩΝΙΚΗΣ ΑΣΦΑΛΙΣΗΣΟργανική μονάδα θεσμικού φορέαΔΙΕΥΘΥΝΣΗ ΑΤΟΜΙΚΩΝ ΡΥΘΜΙΣΕΩΝΕποπτευόμενος ή θεσμικός φορέας ως σημείο εξυπηρέτησηςΔΗΜΟΣΙΑ ΥΠΗΡΕΣΙΑ ΑΠΑΣΧΟΛΗΣΗΣ (Δ.ΥΠ.Α.)Υπηρεσία / οργανική μονάδα εποπτευόμενου φορέαΔιεύθυνση ασφάλισης και κοινωνικών πολιτικώνΠαρέχεται σεΓονείς, ΕργαζόμενουςΣχετικοί σύνδεσμοιΔημόσια Υπηρεσία Απασχόλησης (https://www.dypa.gov.gr/epidoma-gonikis-adeias)Οδηγός του πολίτη - ΔΥΠΑ (https://ticketing.1555.gov.gr/odigosUI/page/categories?cid=cfe9f595-5b2c-11ec-a672-000c2979c70f)Διάρκεια Ισχύος4 μήνες
1ΕΝΤΥΠΟ Ε.14: Δήλωση εργοδότη χορήγησης Γονικής Άδειας (ΠΣΕΡΓΑΝΗ). ...ΔήλωσηΕΝΤΥΠΟ Ε.14: Δήλωση εργοδότη χορήγησης Γονικής Άδειας (ΠΣ ΕΡΓΑΝΗ).Σχετικός σύνδεσμος:Σύνδεσμος (https://www.dypa.gov.gr/epidoma-gonikis-adeias)Κατατίθεται από:Νομικά πρόσωπα, Φορείς του Δημοσίου, Φυσικά πρόσωπαΣημειώσεις:Το Έντυπο Ε.14 δήλωσης χορήγησης της γονικής αδείας αναρτάται από τον εργοδότη στο ΠΣ ΕΡΓΑΝΗ.Περιλαμβάνει τα στοιχεία του εργοδότη & του/της εργαζόμενου/-ης, το είδος, τη μορφή και τηδιάρκεια της εργασιακής σχέσης, τους φορείς κύριας & επικουρικής ασφάλισης, τον ΑΜΚΑ του/τωντέκνου/-ων για το/τα οποίο/-α λαμβάνεται η άδεια, καθώς και το χρονικό διάστημα & τον τρόποχορήγησης της γονικής αδείας.
ΠαρατηρήσειςΔικαιούχοι είναι όλοι οι εργαζόμενοι γονείς ή πρόσωπα που ασκούν τη γονική μέριμνα (φυσικοί, θετοί, ανάδοχοι, τεκμαιρόμενεςμητέρες του άρθρου 1464 του Αστικού Κώδικα που αποκτούν τέκνο με τη διαδικασία της παρένθετης μητρότητας) μέχρι το παιδί νασυμπληρώσει την ηλικία των οκτώ (8) ετών, οι οποίοι απασχολούνται, είτε με σχέση εξαρτημένης εργασίας, είτε με έμμισθη εντολή.Το μηνιαίως καταβαλλόμενο ποσό ισούται με τον εκάστοτε ισχύοντα κατώτατο μισθό και καταβάλλεται και αναλογία δώρωνεορτών και επιδόματος αδείας.Ιδιαίτερη μέριμνα προβλέπεται για τις περιπτώσεις γονέων διδύμων/πολυδύμων οι οποίοι δικαιούνται δύο (2) μήνες επιπλέονεπιδότησης, ανεξαρτήτως του αριθμού των παιδιών που γεννήθηκαν μαζί, καθώς και για γονείς μόνους που ασκούν κατ’αποκλειστικότητα τη γονική μέριμνα οι οποίοι δικαιούνται τον διπλάσιο χρόνο γονικής αδείας & επιδότησης.Η παροχή καταβάλλεται και στις περιπτώσεις ευέλικτου τρόπου λήψης της γονικής αδείας. inputs.preconditions:
- The applicant must be a working parent or a person exercising parental responsibility, including a biological, adoptive or foster parent, or a presumed mother under Article 1464 of the Civil Code who has a child through surrogacy.

- The child must be under eight (8) years of age.

- The applicant must be employed either under a dependent-employment relationship or under a paid mandate, in the private or public sector. In the public sector, the subsidy is available only to employees covered by labour legislation.

- The applicant must have completed one (1) year of employment with the same employer, whether continuously or through successive fixed-term employment contracts, unless more favourable terms are provided by specific legislation, decrees, regulations, collective labour agreements, arbitration awards, or oral or written employer–employee agreements.

- The employer must upload the parental-leave grant form (Form E.14) to the ERGANI Information System.

- For online submission, the applicant must hold TAXISnet credentials to access DYPA electronic services through certification by the Independent Authority for Public Revenue (AADE).

- The applicant must be registered in DYPA’s Register of Natural Persons and hold a DYPA Registration Number; where not already registered, registration is completed electronically using TAXISnet credentials, following verification by AADE.

Εθνικό Μητρώο ΔιοικητικώνΔιαδικασιών505464Επίδομα Γονικής ΆδειαςΜε μια ματιάΣημεία εξυπηρέτησηςΔιεύθυνση ασφάλισης και κοινωνικών πολιτικών, ΔΗΜΟΣΙΑ ΥΠΗΡΕΣΙΑ ΑΠΑΣΧΟΛΗΣΗΣ (Δ.ΥΠ.Α.)Ψηφιακά σημεία παροχήςΕνιαία Ψηφιακή Πύλη δημόσιας διοίκησης (ΕΨΠ - gov.gr) (https://www.gov.gr/ipiresies/ergasia-kai-asphalise/apozemioseis-kai-parokhes/epidoma-gonikes-adeias)Αριθμός δικαιολογητικών1ΚόστοςΠαρέχεται χωρίς κόστοςΕκτιμώμενος χρόνος3 μήνεςΠεριγραφήΗ διαδικασία αφορά στη χορήγηση επιδόματος γονικής άδειας. Η εν θέματι παροχή χορηγείται από τη Δημόσια ΥπηρεσίαΑπασχόλησης (Δ.ΥΠ.Α.) για τους πρώτους δύο (2) μήνες γονικής αδείας διάρκειας έως τέσσερις (4) μήνες.Βασικές πληροφορίεςΘεσμικός φορέαςΥΠΟΥΡΓΕΙΟ ΕΡΓΑΣΙΑΣ ΚΑΙ ΚΟΙΝΩΝΙΚΗΣ ΑΣΦΑΛΙΣΗΣΟργανική μονάδα θεσμικού φορέαΔΙΕΥΘΥΝΣΗ ΑΤΟΜΙΚΩΝ ΡΥΘΜΙΣΕΩΝΕποπτευόμενος ή θεσμικός φορέας ως σημείο εξυπηρέτησηςΔΗΜΟΣΙΑ ΥΠΗΡΕΣΙΑ ΑΠΑΣΧΟΛΗΣΗΣ (Δ.ΥΠ.Α.)Υπηρεσία / οργανική μονάδα εποπτευόμενου φορέαΔιεύθυνση ασφάλισης και κοινωνικών πολιτικώνΠαρέχεται σεΓονείς, ΕργαζόμενουςΣχετικοί σύνδεσμοιΔημόσια Υπηρεσία Απασχόλησης (https://www.dypa.gov.gr/epidoma-gonikis-adeias)Οδηγός του πολίτη - ΔΥΠΑ (https://ticketing.1555.gov.gr/odigosUI/page/categories?cid=cfe9f595-5b2c-11ec-a672-000c2979c70f)Διάρκεια Ισχύος4 μήνες
1ΕΝΤΥΠΟ Ε.14: Δήλωση εργοδότη χορήγησης Γονικής Άδειας (ΠΣΕΡΓΑΝΗ). ...ΔήλωσηΕΝΤΥΠΟ Ε.14: Δήλωση εργοδότη χορήγησης Γονικής Άδειας (ΠΣ ΕΡΓΑΝΗ).Σχετικός σύνδεσμος:Σύνδεσμος (https://www.dypa.gov.gr/epidoma-gonikis-adeias)Κατατίθεται από:Νομικά πρόσωπα, Φορείς του Δημοσίου, Φυσικά πρόσωπαΣημειώσεις:Το Έντυπο Ε.14 δήλωσης χορήγησης της γονικής αδείας αναρτάται από τον εργοδότη στο ΠΣ ΕΡΓΑΝΗ.Περιλαμβάνει τα στοιχεία του εργοδότη & του/της εργαζόμενου/-ης, το είδος, τη μορφή και τηδιάρκεια της εργασιακής σχέσης, τους φορείς κύριας & επικουρικής ασφάλισης, τον ΑΜΚΑ του/τωντέκνου/-ων για το/τα οποίο/-α λαμβάνεται η άδεια, καθώς και το χρονικό διάστημα & τον τρόποχορήγησης της γονικής αδείας.
ΠαρατηρήσειςΔικαιούχοι είναι όλοι οι εργαζόμενοι γονείς ή πρόσωπα που ασκούν τη γονική μέριμνα (φυσικοί, θετοί, ανάδοχοι, τεκμαιρόμενεςμητέρες του άρθρου 1464 του Αστικού Κώδικα που αποκτούν τέκνο με τη διαδικασία της παρένθετης μητρότητας) μέχρι το παιδί νασυμπληρώσει την ηλικία των οκτώ (8) ετών, οι οποίοι απασχολούνται, είτε με σχέση εξαρτημένης εργασίας, είτε με έμμισθη εντολή.Το μηνιαίως καταβαλλόμενο ποσό ισούται με τον εκάστοτε ισχύοντα κατώτατο μισθό και καταβάλλεται και αναλογία δώρωνεορτών και επιδόματος αδείας.Ιδιαίτερη μέριμνα προβλέπεται για τις περιπτώσεις γονέων διδύμων/πολυδύμων οι οποίοι δικαιούνται δύο (2) μήνες επιπλέονεπιδότησης, ανεξαρτήτως του αριθμού των παιδιών που γεννήθηκαν μαζί, καθώς και για γονείς μόνους που ασκούν κατ’αποκλειστικότητα τη γονική μέριμνα οι οποίοι δικαιούνται τον διπλάσιο χρόνο γονικής αδείας & επιδότησης.Η παροχή καταβάλλεται και στις περιπτώσεις ευέλικτου τρόπου λήψης της γονικής αδείας. Επίσης, κατά τη διάρκεια της επιδότησηςοι δικαιούχοι ασφαλίζονται στον κλάδο κύριας σύνταξης και ασθένειας του e-ΕΦΚΑ και στον κλάδο επικουρικής ασφάλισης.Τελευταία ενημέρωση09/04/2025ΑίτησηΤύπος αίτησηςΑίτησηΚατάθεσηΚατάθεση από τον αιτούντα (ψηφιακή)Κατατίθεται απόΦυσικά πρόσωπαΤίτλοςΑίτηση χορήγησης του επιδόματος γονικής αδείας.Σχετικός σύνδεσμοςΣύνδεσμος (https://eservices.oaed.gr/pls/apex/f?p=1001:1:0:::::)Τι θα χρειαστείτεΜέσα εξακρίβωσης της ταυτότητας, ταυτοποίησης και υπογραφήςΤαυτοποίηση με κωδικούς TAXISnet

inputs.preconditions:
- The applicant must be a working parent or a person exercising parental responsibility, including a biological, adoptive or foster parent, or a presumed mother under Article 1464 of the Civil Code who has a child through surrogacy.

- The child must be under eight (8) years of age.

- The applicant must be employed either under a dependent-employment relationship or under a paid mandate, in the private or public sector. In the public sector, the subsidy is available only to employees covered by labour legislation.

- The applicant must have completed one (1) year of employment with the same employer, whether continuously or through successive fixed-term employment contracts, unless more favourable terms are provided by specific legislation, decrees, regulations, collective labour agreements, arbitration awards, or oral or written employer–employee agreements.

- The employer must upload the parental-leave grant form (Form E.14) to the ERGANI Information System.

- For online submission, the applicant must hold TAXISnet credentials to access DYPA electronic services through certification by the Independent Authority for Public Revenue (AADE).

- The applicant must be registered in DYPA’s Register of Natural Persons and hold a DYPA Registration Number; where not already registered, registration is completed electronically using TAXISnet credentials, following verification by AADE.

inputs.preconditions:
- The applicant must be a working parent or a person exercising parental responsibility, including a biological, adoptive or foster parent, or a presumed mother under Article 1464 of the Civil Code who has a child through surrogacy.

- The child must be under eight (8) years of age.

- The applicant must be employed either under a dependent-employment relationship or under a paid mandate, in the private or public sector. In the public sector, the subsidy is available only to employees covered by labour legislation.

- The applicant must have completed one (1) year of employment with the same employer, whether continuously or through successive fixed-term employment contracts, unless more favourable terms are provided by specific legislation, decrees, regulations, collective labour agreements, arbitration awards, or oral or written employer–employee agreements.

- The employer must upload the parental-leave grant form (Form E.14) to the ERGANI Information System.

- For online submission, the applicant must hold TAXISnet credentials to access DYPA electronic services through certification by the Independent Authority for Public Revenue (AADE).

- The applicant must be registered in DYPA’s Register of Natural Persons and hold a DYPA Registration Number; where not already registered, registration is completed electronically using TAXISnet credentials, following verification by AADE.

### SYSTEM INSTRUCTIONS
You are a SHACL Expert. Your task is to generate a strictly valid SHACL file (Turtle format) to validate a Knowledge Graph against a set of constraints.

### INPUTS
1.  **Information Model (JSON):** An array of constraint objects. Each constraint identifies the required data variables (constrains) and how to find them in the graph (related_paths).
2.  **Domain Ontology (TTL):** The definitions of the classes and properties used in the paths. 

### OUTPUT
A single `.ttl` file containing `sh:NodeShape` definitions. DO NOT wrap the output in markdown code blocks; return ONLY the raw Turtle string. 

### GENERATION RULES

1.  **Targeting:**
    * Every Shape MUST target the class `:Applicant`.
    * Use: `sh:targetClass :Applicant ;`.

2.  **Namespace & Prefixes:**
    * Use the namespace defined in the Domain Ontology for all properties (`@prefix : <http://example.org/schema#> .`).
    * Use the example namespace for the shapes (`@prefix ex: <http://example.org/> .`).
    * Include standard prefixes: `sh:`, `xsd:`, `rdf:`, `rdfs:`.

3.  **Path Resolution:**
    * The `path` arrays in the JSON are lists of predicate names (strings).
    * You must prepend the default namespace (e.g., `:`) to these strings to create valid URIs (e.g., "hasParent" -> `:hasParent`).
    * All paths originate from the **Focus Node** (the `:Applicant`).
    * Use the related_paths in the JSON strictly as a dictionary to know which Ontology properties exist. DO NOT blindly chain them together. You must read the natural language desc to understand the true relational graph topology (e.g., realizing that multiple properties belong to the same Blank Node) and construct your SPARQL WHERE clauses based on the English logic, not the flat JSON arrays.

3.5. **Empty Constraints:**
    * If a Constraint object in the JSON Information Model has an empty `constrains` array (no InformationConcepts), this means the precondition could not be mapped to any property in the Domain Ontology.
    * Do NOT generate a `sh:NodeShape` for this Constraint. Skip it entirely.
    * Do NOT generate a stub shape with only `sh:targetClass` and an explanatory `sh:message` — such a shape has no constraint component and will cause the validation engine to fail.

4.  **Logic Strategy (Property vs. SPARQL):**
    * **Strategy A: Simple Property Shapes**
        * Use ONLY if there is exactly **one** concept with **one** path, and the logic is a simple check (e.g., `minCount`, `minInclusive`, `hasValue`).
        * *Example:* "Income > 1000" on a direct path.
    * **Strategy B: SPARQL Constraints (Default for Complexity)**
        * Use for **ANY** of the following:
            * **Multiple Paths:** (e.g., Applicant's income + Parent's income).
            * **Identity/URI Checks:** (e.g., "City A must be different from City B").
            * **Aggregations:** (Sum, Count).
            * **Complex Math:** (Income > 3000 + (300 * children)).

5.  **SPARQL Syntax Rules:**
    * Use `?this` to refer to the focus node (:Applicant).
    * **Do NOT use Property Paths** (e.g., `ex:p1/ex:p2`) in the WHERE clause. Break them down into explicit triple patterns for robustness.
        * *Bad:* `?this :hasParent/:hasIncome ?val .`
        * *Good:* `?this :hasParent ?p . ?p :hasIncome ?val .`
    * **Datatype Handling:**
        * If JSON datatype is `"URI"`, compare variables directly (e.g., `FILTER (?city1 != ?city2)`).
        * If JSON datatype is numeric (`xsd:decimal`), perform arithmetic comparisons.

6.  **Message:**
    * Generate a clear `sh:message` explaining the violation (usually the inverse of the `desc`).

7.  **Date & Duration Logic:**
    * Use `now()` to represent the current date/time. For example:
    * To calculate **Age** (Years): Use `(YEAR(now()) - YEAR(?birthDate))`.
    * To calculate **Elapsed Months** (Duration): Use `((YEAR(now()) * 12 + MONTH(now())) - (YEAR(?startDate) * 12 + MONTH(?startDate)))`.
    * Always use these mathematical breakdowns rather than subtracting dates directly, as `xsd:duration` support varies by validator.

### EXAMPLES

**Example 1: Identity Check (URI Comparison)**
*JSON Input:*
[
    {
    "name": "different_city_condition",
    "desc": "Student residence must be in a different city than family.",
    "constrains": [
        { "name": "stud_city", "related_paths": [{ "path": ["hasCurrentResidence", "locatedIn"], "datatype": "URI" }] },
        { "name": "fam_city", "related_paths": [{ "path": ["hasFamilyResidence", "locatedIn"], "datatype": "URI" }] }
        ]
    }
]
*SHACL Output:*
:different_city_shape
    a sh:NodeShape ;
    sh:targetClass :Applicant ;
    sh:sparql [
        a sh:SPARQLConstraint ;
        sh:message "Student residence is in the same city as the family residence." ;
        sh:select """
            SELECT ?this
            WHERE {
                # Path 1: Student City
                ?this :hasCurrentResidence ?res .
                ?res :locatedIn ?stud_city .
                
                # Path 2: Family City
                ?this :hasFamilyResidence ?fres .
                ?fres :locatedIn ?fam_city .
                
                # Constraint: Must be different
                FILTER (?stud_city = ?fam_city)
            }
        """ ;
    ] .

**Example 2: Aggregation (Summing across paths)**
*JSON Input:*
[
    {
    "name": "income_limit_condition",
    "desc": "Total family income must be less than 30000.",
    "constrains": [
            { "name": "family_income", "related_paths": [
                { "path": ["hasIncome", "amount"], "datatype": "xsd:decimal" },
                { "path": ["hasParent", "hasIncome", "amount"], "datatype": "xsd:decimal" }
                ]
            }
        ]
    }
]
*SHACL Output:*
:income_limit_shape
    a sh:NodeShape ;
    sh:targetClass :Applicant ;
    sh:sparql [
        a sh:SPARQLConstraint ;
        sh:message "Total family income exceeds 30000." ;
        sh:select """
            SELECT ?this
            WHERE {
                {
                    # Step 2: Sum the values of those distinct nodes
                    SELECT ?this (SUM(?val) as ?total)
                    WHERE {
                        # Step 1: Isolate DISTINCT property nodes to prevent double-counting shared graphs
                        SELECT DISTINCT ?this ?node ?val
                        WHERE {
                            {
                                # Path A: Applicant
                                ?this :hasIncome ?node .
                                ?node :amount ?val .
                            }
                            UNION
                            {
                                # Path B: Parent
                                ?this :hasParent ?par .
                                ?par :hasIncome ?node .
                                ?node :amount ?val .
                            }
                        }
                    }
                    GROUP BY ?this
                }
                FILTER (?total > 30000)
            }
        """ ;
    ] .

inputs.preconditions:
- The applicant must be a working parent or a person exercising parental responsibility, including a biological, adoptive or foster parent, or a presumed mother under Article 1464 of the Civil Code who has a child through surrogacy.

- The child must be under eight (8) years of age.

- The applicant must be employed either under a dependent-employment relationship or under a paid mandate, in the private or public sector. In the public sector, the subsidy is available only to employees covered by labour legislation.

- The applicant must have completed one (1) year of employment with the same employer, whether continuously or through successive fixed-term employment contracts, unless more favourable terms are provided by specific legislation, decrees, regulations, collective labour agreements, arbitration awards, or oral or written employer–employee agreements.

- The employer must upload the parental-leave grant form (Form E.14) to the ERGANI Information System.

- For online submission, the applicant must hold TAXISnet credentials to access DYPA electronic services through certification by the Independent Authority for Public Revenue (AADE).

- The applicant must be registered in DYPA’s Register of Natural Persons and hold a DYPA Registration Number; where not already registered, registration is completed electronically using TAXISnet credentials, following verification by AADE.

inputs.preconditions:
- The applicant must be a working parent or a person exercising parental responsibility, including a biological, adoptive or foster parent, or a presumed mother under Article 1464 of the Civil Code who has a child through surrogacy.

- The child must be under eight (8) years of age.

- The applicant must be employed either under a dependent-employment relationship or under a paid mandate, in the private or public sector. In the public sector, the subsidy is available only to employees covered by labour legislation.

- The applicant must have completed one (1) year of employment with the same employer, whether continuously or through successive fixed-term employment contracts, unless more favourable terms are provided by specific legislation, decrees, regulations, collective labour agreements, arbitration awards, or oral or written employer–employee agreements.

- The employer must upload the parental-leave grant form (Form E.14) to the ERGANI Information System.

- For online submission, the applicant must hold TAXISnet credentials to access DYPA electronic services through certification by the Independent Authority for Public Revenue (AADE).

- The applicant must be registered in DYPA’s Register of Natural Persons and hold a DYPA Registration Number; where not already registered, registration is completed electronically using TAXISnet credentials, following verification by AADE.

inputs.preconditions:
- The applicant must be a working parent or a person exercising parental responsibility, including a biological, adoptive or foster parent, or a presumed mother under Article 1464 of the Civil Code who has a child through surrogacy.

- The child must be under eight (8) years of age.

- The applicant must be employed either under a dependent-employment relationship or under a paid mandate, in the private or public sector. In the public sector, the subsidy is available only to employees covered by labour legislation.

- The applicant must have completed one (1) year of employment with the same employer, whether continuously or through successive fixed-term employment contracts, unless more favourable terms are provided by specific legislation, decrees, regulations, collective labour agreements, arbitration awards, or oral or written employer–employee agreements.

- The employer must upload the parental-leave grant form (Form E.14) to the ERGANI Information System.

- For online submission, the applicant must hold TAXISnet credentials to access DYPA electronic services through certification by the Independent Authority for Public Revenue (AADE).

- The applicant must be registered in DYPA’s Register of Natural Persons and hold a DYPA Registration Number; where not already registered, registration is completed electronically using TAXISnet credentials, following verification by AADE.

inputs.preconditions:
- The applicant must be a working parent or a person exercising parental responsibility, including a biological, adoptive or foster parent, or a presumed mother under Article 1464 of the Civil Code who has a child through surrogacy.

- The child must be under eight (8) years of age.

- The applicant must be employed either under a dependent-employment relationship or under a paid mandate, in the private or public sector. In the public sector, the subsidy is available only to employees covered by labour legislation.

- The applicant must have completed one (1) year of employment with the same employer, whether continuously or through successive fixed-term employment contracts, unless more favourable terms are provided by specific legislation, decrees, regulations, collective labour agreements, arbitration awards, or oral or written employer–employee agreements.

- The employer must upload the parental-leave grant form (Form E.14) to the ERGANI Information System.

- For online submission, the applicant must hold TAXISnet credentials to access DYPA electronic services through certification by the Independent Authority for Public Revenue (AADE).

- The applicant must be registered in DYPA’s Register of Natural Persons and hold a DYPA Registration Number; where not already registered, registration is completed electronically using TAXISnet credentials, following verification by AADE.
